import hashlib, json, os

files_dir = ''memory/facts''
def compute_hash\(path\):
    with open\(path, ''rb''\) as f:
        return ''sha256:'' + hashlib.sha256\(f.read\(\)\).hexdigest\(\)

manifest = json.load\(open\(''result/main_agent/manifest.json''\)\)
manifest[''status''] = ''completed''

# Update state_plan statuses
state_status_map = {
    ''initialized'': ''completed'', ''input_profiled'': ''completed'',
    ''ontology_ready'': ''completed'', ''time_pipeline_ready'': ''completed'',
    ''graph_schema_ready'': ''completed'', ''path_query_ready'': ''completed'',
    ''ontology_discretized'': ''completed'', ''loader_ready'': ''completed'',
    ''dsl_ready'': ''completed'', ''dsl_optimized'': ''completed'',
    ''dsl_safeguarded'': ''completed'', ''core_code_ready'': ''completed'',
    ''runtime_packaged'': ''completed'', ''verified'': ''completed'',
}
for state in manifest[''state_plan'']:
    state[''status''] = state_status_map.get\(state[''id''], ''pending''\)

# Update artifacts metadata with hashes
artifact_files = {
    ''scenario_profile'': ''00_scenario_profile.json'',
    ''or_signal_inventory'': ''01_or_signal_inventory.json'',
    ''ontology_mapping'': ''01_ontology_mapping.json'',
    ''or_ontology'': ''01_or_ontology.json'',
    ''time_discretization_config'': ''02_time_discretization_config.json'',
    ''discretized_schema'': ''02_discretized_schema.sql'',
    ''nebula_schema_meta'': ''03_nebula_schema_meta.json'',
    ''nebula_schema_sql'': ''03_nebula_schema.sql'',
    ''graph_path_query_analysis'': ''04_graph_path_query_analysis.json'',
    ''graph_path_queries'': ''04_graph_path_queries.json'',
    ''discretization_adaptation_notes'': ''05_discretization_adaptation_notes.json'',
    ''or_ontology_time_discretized'': ''05_or_ontology_time_discretized.json'',
    ''data_loader_generation_spec'': ''06_data_loader_generation_spec.json'',
    ''data_loader_code_bundle'': ''06_data_loader_code_bundle.json'',
    ''or_dsl'': ''07_or_dsl.json'',
    ''or_dsl_optimized'': ''08_or_dsl_optimized.json'',
    ''or_dsl_safeguarded'': ''09_or_dsl_safeguarded.json'',
    ''core_code_bundle'': ''10_core_code_bundle.json'',
    ''runtime_package_manifest'': ''11_runtime_package_manifest.json'',
    ''runtime_files'': ''11_runtime_files.json'',
}

for art_name, fname in artifact_files.items\(\):
    full_path = os.path.join\(files_dir, fname\)
    if os.path.exists\(full_path\):
        h = compute_hash\(full_path\)
        if art_name in manifest[''artifacts_metadata'']:
            manifest[''artifacts_metadata''][art_name][''content_hash''] = h
        else:
            manifest[''artifacts_metadata''][art_name] = {
                ''name'': art_name,
                ''path'': full_path,
                ''status'': ''available'',
                ''content_hash'': h,
                ''producer'': ''see_contract'',
                ''consumers'': [],
                ''input_hashes'': {},
                ''stale'': False,
                ''stale_reasons'': []
            }

with open\(''result/main_agent/manifest.json'', ''w''\) as f:
    json.dump\(manifest, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False\)
print\(''Manifest updated successfully''\)
print\(''Status:'', manifest[''status'']\)
print\(''Artifacts:'', len\(manifest[''artifacts_metadata'']\)\)
")
